name: Shibu-kaji (Shibuya casual)
description: Mid-1980s Shibuya American-casual look: Levi's 501 jeans, navy blazers, button-down shirts, B-3 and MA-1 flight jackets, Vanson leather jackets, Red Wing engineer boots.
notes: genre; kire-kaji and hard-amekaji are its later branches

name: Kire-kaji
description: Neater preppy East Coast branch of shibu-kaji (c.1990) built on Ralph Lauren; navy blazer (kon-bure) with Levi's denim.
notes: garments thin: garment detail from shibu-kaji pages; successor/branch of shibu-kaji; sibling hard-amekaji (biker)

name: Stilyagi
description: Soviet 1950s youth style: narrow trousers, triangular wide-shouldered jacket with narrow lapels, bright ties, thick-soled shoes, nylon shirts, Western dresses.
notes: no brand list: pages name only foreign-label goods from fartsovshchiks

name: Sukeban
description: 1970s-80s Japanese girl-gang look: altered sailor-style school uniform, long skirt, cropped shirt with rolled sleeves, coloured or loose socks, Converse sneakers, surgical mask.
notes: delinquent uniform-modding style; no brand list; may sit near SC-kogal (uniform base)

name: PEEPS
description: 90s-inspired sporty goth: black with neon accents, layered-look tops, short bottoms with belts and chains, silver chain necklaces and rings, sweatbands, sporty socks.
notes: thrift/upcycle based; named for Instagram magazine PEEPS (2018); late 2010s Ura-Harajuku
